name: australian-accounting-skills
description: Australian public-practice and contracting-business workflow skills. Prep-only. Not lodgment. Not tax advice.

safety.noLodgmentBoundary: Never lodge, file, submit, transmit, declare, pay, or finalise any tax return, BAS, FBT return, STP report, or other material with the ATO or any government agency.

interface.shortDescription: Public-practice BAS, FBT, Div 7A and STP workflows
interface.longDescription: Nineteen workflow skills for Australian public-practice and contracting-business accounting. Each skill encodes steps, tie-outs and escalation boundaries, then sends the agent to current primary sources for mutable rules. Outputs are review-ready workpapers. An authorised human reviews, decides and lodges. Not tax advice. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Australian Taxation Office.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a BAS workpaper for the quarter ended 31 March from these exports. Cash basis, quarterly lodger. Tie 1A less 1B to the GST control account movement and list exceptions.
